card.name: Per-kilogram dose units after a number
card.fires_on: The "/kg" part of a weight-based dose such as "15 mg/kg" or "0.6 mcg/kg". It also fires on "an" in "Premedicate patients with an" before a drug class.

modes.label: Per-kg dose unit
modes.description: The "/kg" part of a weight-based dose right after a mg or mcg amount.
modes.example: At the recommended dose of 0.9 mg<</kg>>/day of deflazacort oral

modes.label: Premedication "an"
modes.description: The article "an" after "Premedicate patients with", before a drug class such as antihistamine or antipyretic.
